name: Al Rajhi Company for Cooperative Insurance
summary: Al Rajhi Company for Cooperative Insurance provides various insurance products and services to individuals and businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates in four segments: Medical, Motor, Property and Casualty, and Protection and Savings. It offers motor, travel, visa extension, medical malpractice, protection and savings, domestic helper health, home and contents, domestic worker contract, and cyber insurance products, as well as fire and engineering insurance.
